brief: Kestrel Ledger is a UK company in Leeds that runs outsourced bookkeeping, payroll, HR administration and finance systems support for accountancy practices, schools and academy trusts, and growing companies. Over 3,000 organisations use Kestrel Ledger every month. Brand colours: slate #26313D and blue #1F6FD1. Services: bookkeeping, payroll, HR administration, management accounts, finance systems support. Client wordmarks we may show: Harrow Lane Accountants, Oakfield Academy Trust, Northgate Retail, Pennine Dental, Castleford Hotels, Marlow and Finch, Wren Valley Schools, Ashby Engineering. Reviews: "Month-end used to take our team a full week. Kestrel Ledger closes the books in three days and flags anything odd before our partners ask." (Priya Shah, Practice Manager, Harrow Lane Accountants). "Payroll for four schools now runs on one calendar. Our business manager spends Fridays on budgets instead of chasing timesheets." (Gareth Ellis, Chief Financial Officer, Oakfield Academy Trust). "They moved us off spreadsheets and onto Xero without losing a single supplier record. The handover notes were better than our own." (Hannah Cole, Finance Director, Northgate Retail). Articles: "Making Tax Digital for income tax: what practices should prepare this year" (Guide, 6 min read); "Five payroll checks that catch errors before payday" (Blog, 4 min read); "How academy trusts can share one finance team across schools" (Case study, 5 min read). Phone: +44 113 496 0000, Monday to Friday, 8.30am to 5.30pm. Privacy page: https://kestrelledger.example/privacy.
